title: Expected Value as Local Expected Value
statement: Let a finite CSP template over a finite label set be given, together with a finite CSP instance having at least one constraint and a randomized assignment that independently samples each variable according to its prescribed marginal law. The expected fraction of satisfied constraint occurrences equals the sum of the constraints’ local satisfaction probabilities divided by the number of constraint occurrences.
hypotheses_covered: CSP template and finite predicate family
Randomized assignment with a marginal law for each variable
